C-13.Name: Retire the Mark Text v1.x settings/data migration pipeline
C-13.Summary: User decision: "выпилить функционал миграции настроек из старого марка, аккуратно — темы и угловые случаи не задеть". Remove the one-time v1.x import pipeline: the m005_migrate module (snapshot loader, preferences/dataCenter/keybindings/recent-docs/keychain steps, fixture e2e), legacy-layout detection, the snapshot copier, the dead prefs stub gate, the migration dialog strings, the cancel-rate log, the migration dialogs, and the main.rs bootstrap block that drives them. KEEP everything that is live state, not import: the m005_prefs store with its mt_migration namespace (alpha install detection + store versioning), m_v1_compat IPC shims, the renderer v1-format persistence (window state, tabs, layout), and themes (served as-is from preferences.json).

Problem.Description: ~4700 lines of one-time import code ship in every build and complicate every prefs change.
Problem.RootCause: The port carried a full v1.x migration pipeline from Phase B3; the existing user base has completed it and fresh installs never had v1 data.
Problem.Evidence: src-tauri/src/m005_migrate/ (10 files, 3666 lines incl. fixture_e2e), legacy.rs (211), snapshot.rs (276), prefs.rs stub (101), migration_strings.rs (327), cancel_log.rs (236), main.rs bootstrap block ~lines 269-451, dialog.rs ask_migration/map_result/DialogChoice; no renderer or vitest references (grep); m005_prefs mt_migration namespace is LIVE (alpha-install detection, store versioning) and stays.

Goals.R-1: Delete m005_migrate/, legacy.rs, snapshot.rs, prefs.rs, migration_strings.rs, cancel_log.rs; strip the main.rs bootstrap block (detection, MARK_SKIP_MIGRATION, 5-marker check, snapshot, runner, dialogs) down to a single BLOCK_MIGRATION_RETIRED boot log; drop the now-dead mod decls, the dialog::DialogChoice import, and the ask_migration/map_result/MigrationStrings surface from dialog.rs (ask_native_error stays — m001_security/validate/panic call it; the dead ask_native_info went too, pass-1 finding).
Goals.R-2: Preserve live behavior bit-for-bit: m005_prefs PrefsStore and its mt_migration namespace untouched (comment-only contract refresh — the header still pointed at the deleted prefs.rs stub); m_v1_compat untouched; renderer untouched; existing preferences.json / window state / tabs restore unaffected; themes served as-is.
Goals.R-3: Governance: M-005 graph summary/contract reworded (migration retired, store remains); V-M-005 migration scenarios retired with an explicit note; main.rs MODULE_CONTRACT/CHANGE_SUMMARY updated.
Goals.R-4: Gates: full cargo test, npm test, grace lint; CUA live check — theme change survives an app restart, tabs/window state restore, clean boot log carries BLOCK_MIGRATION_RETIRED.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not touch m005_prefs mt_migration namespace semantics (alpha detection depends on it).
Failed-removal safety: if anything outside the listed surface references a removed symbol, cargo must fail the build (no allow(unused) masking).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Cleaning cached migration snapshots on disk (harmless leftovers in the cache root).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cargo test + npm test green; binary boots to the editor with BLOCK_MIGRATION_RETIRED in stderr and no dialogs.
Theme switch persists across restart; tabs and window geometry restore as before.
No dead_code allowances left behind for the removed surface.

C-13.VerificationIntent: cargo test (fixture_e2e goes with the module); full renderer suite; CUA restart-persistence of theme + session.

Approval.ApprovedBy: user (session 2026-09-17): "предлагаю выпилить функционал миграции настроек из старого марка. только внимательно аккуратно с темами и корнерами ничего не задеть"
Approval.ApprovalScope: Full gates: tests, 2 reviews, CUA live check, commit.
